Features

The product surfaces follow the ledger.

This page is intentionally concrete: each feature is framed around the row or invariant that makes the claim true.

Ledger primitives

Trezzit stores bills as Bill rows, line items as BillItem rows, and every person portion as ItemShare rows. This is the core reason the product can split, categorize, budget, and answer AI queries from the same item-level record instead of mapping between incompatible abstractions.

Split engine

Trezzit supports five split methods: equal, percentage, exact, shares, and adjusted. Because split_type lives on the ItemShare row, one receipt can mix methods across items without turning the bill into a compromise.

Receipt ingestion

Receipt scanning turns a real receipt into ledger rows, then validation checks the math before the bill is saved. The marketing scaffold keeps this honest by showing extraction, reconciliation, and review as one pipeline.

Personal finance

Every ItemShare can carry its own category and tags. That means your half of dinner can be personal Food while another person uses a different category, without changing the shared bill.

Groups and settlements

Groups lock currency at creation, and settlements are stored as paired Payment rows. Balance reads come from pre-aggregated pairwise rows updated inside the same transaction as bill changes.

CSV import

Splitwise import uses a five-step CSV flow: Upload, Group, You, Map, Done. Unknown names can become placeholder members, and the backend rolls back if recomputed balances do not match the Splitwise total balance row within one cent.

Notifications and PWA

Trezzit is a web product with PWA support and web push. This site avoids native app or mobile push claims because the shipped surface is web-first.
